---
name: Idea / improvement
about: Suggest a runtime improvement, catalog sound, or website/docs change.
---

Ideas of any size are welcome. Share what you can; no formal proposal is needed.

## Problem or use case

What are you trying to do, and what is missing or difficult today?

## Proposed improvement

Describe your idea. It could be a runtime improvement, a new or improved catalog
sound, or a website/documentation change. For sounds, describe the character and
interaction you have in mind.

## Why it would help

How would this help developers or users?
